entries.clue: A tall stem at the water's edge
Green jumper with a loud evening song
A flower that floats on a flat green pad
A ring spreading from a dropped pebble
A tall grey bird standing very still
A small amphibian with a tail
A brown fuzzy spike on a marsh stalk
A tiny fish in a school
Wet earth that sticks to boots
A glittering hoverer over the shallows
